name: Foul Magics

angles.text: As an orc, you carry a deep and painful history of demonic corruption. Residual fel magic can make your blood boil and stir unnatural rage, as Tor'gan feels near Northfold Manor.
As a member of the Horde, you know Hammerfall is its lone outpost in the Arathi Highlands. Dark summoners just west of the settlement pose a direct security threat.
As a warlock, you know the rituals and binding reagents needed to summon demons. The bloodstone amulets at Northfold Manor are objects of particular interest.

faq.answer: Tor'gan gives the request from Hammerfall, the Horde stronghold in the Arathi Highlands. Sensing a demonic presence nearby, he asks travelers to investigate Northfold Manor.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Foul Magics?

faq.answer: Northfold Manor lies west of Hammerfall, in the northern hills of the Arathi Highlands. Once a human homestead, it is now the site of covert demonic summonings using bloodstone charms.
Bloodstone amulets help practitioners channel dark magic during demonic summonings. When a summoning drains an amulet's power, the charm is depleted.
faq.q: What are Bloodstone Amulets used for?

faq.answer: Lingering demonic summoning energies near Northfold Manor stir Tor'gan's rage. Fel magic makes his blood boil and ignites an uncontrollable rage.
faq.q: Why does Tor'gan feel rage near Northfold Manor?

aliases: why wont torgan go to northfold
faq.answer: Tor'gan fears the residual demonic power will stir dangerous rage in him. Worried he could lose control or succumb to its corrupting influence, he asks others to recover the amulets.
faq.q: Why does Tor'gan refuse to return to Northfold Manor?

faq.answer: Tor'gan asks for ten bloodstone amulets from Northfold Manor. The one he found was depleted, so he needs multiple charged specimens to study and understand the rituals there.
faq.q: How many Bloodstone Amulets are needed?

faq.answer: Dark practitioners at Northfold Manor conduct demonic summonings. Their rituals and the fel residue drew Tor'gan's attention from Hammerfall and led to the Horde's investigation.
faq.q: Who is summoning demons at Northfold Manor?

sections.body: Demonic energy stirs in the Arathi Highlands, and Tor'gan feels it from his post at Hammerfall. The pull draws the orc west toward Northfold Manor. There, he finds signs of demonic summoning, but the lingering corruption makes his blood boil and stirs an involuntary rage tied to the blood curse's history. He retreats before the influence overwhelms his senses, then seeks help from others.
sections.title: A Simmering Rage

sections.body: At Northfold Manor, Tor'gan found a bloodstone amulet on the ground. It showed that dark rituals were being performed there. Such charms help channel and steady demonic summonings, but the amulet he recovered had lost its magic. It held too little power for a thorough study. Tor'gan asks Horde travelers to retrieve ten intact amulets from the manor's practitioners, so he can examine the rituals and learn what entities were summoned.
sections.title: The Bloodstone Amulets

summary: In the Arathi Highlands, Tor'gan follows a demonic presence to Northfold Manor. From Hammerfall, he seeks help recovering bloodstone amulets from the summoners.
